title: Memory leak when resizing the Project Manager to minimum width
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible on v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe] - Not reproducible on v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d] ### System information Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9227) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 31.34 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description After doing the "Steps to reproduce" these errors appear: ``` WARNING: 34 RIDs of type "CanvasItem" were leaked. at: _free_rids (servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp:2735) ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'N5GLES37TextureE' were leaked at exit. ERROR: Texture with GL ID of 39: leaked 1364 bytes. at: ~Utilities (drivers/gles3/storage/utilities.cpp:82) ERROR: 34 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced22ShapedTextDataAdvancedE' were leaked at exit. ERROR: 1 RID allocations of type 'PN18TextServerAdvanced12FontAdvancedE' were leaked at exit. WARNING: 94 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit (run with `--verbose` for details). at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2527) ```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4fbffb99-f1a8-41da-a244-fb93953a2c41 Interesting thing is that dev3 allows the width to be much smaller. Additional system info: Editor Scale 100% ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the Project Manager 2. Switch to Asset Store 3. ~Ensure Online mode is ON~ Also happens with offline mode 4. Resize the window horizontally to the minimum width ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
